name: clip-wallet-typed-data
description: Graded against the running dapp. Without the extension installed the page must explain how to load it; with it, each step goes through the wallet's approval window.

assertions.statement: The home page names this wallet (not Clip Wallet) and explains how to load the extension when it isn't installed.
howToVerify: Open http://localhost:3000/ in a browser without the extension.
Confirm the heading is the name in packages/extension/wallet.identity.json.
Confirm step 1 says the wallet isn't installed and lists pnpm extension:build and Load unpacked.

assertions.statement: The debug page lists Hedera's PRNG and exchange-rate system contracts on Hedera testnet.
howToVerify: Confirm HederaPrng and HederaExchangeRate are listed with addresses 0x…0169 and 0x…0168.

assertions.statement: A 'Sign typed data' step exists and is disabled until the wallet is connected.
howToVerify: Confirm a 'Sign typed data' card with a disabled button.

assertions.statement: With the extension loaded and a testnet wallet created, signing typed data opens the wallet's approval window and the page reports a valid signature.
howToVerify: pnpm extension:build; load packages/extension/.output/chrome-mv3 unpacked; create a wallet.
Connect on http://localhost:3000/, click the typed-data Sign button, approve.
Confirm the page reports a valid signature.
